description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractViewHandler which implements the ViewHandler interface. It provides basic functionality for managing the 'name' property of a view handler within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: AbstractViewHandler
classes.description: An abstract class that manages the 'name' property for view handlers, implementing the ViewHandler interface.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the view handler.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the view handler.
